name: etsy-pp-mcp
description: Etsy Open API v3 commands plus a local SQLite store for offline fee reports, ledger reconciliation, listing and GPSR audits, market research, and previewed bulk edits.

etsy_api_key.title: ETSY_API_KEY
etsy_api_key.description: Sets ETSY_API_KEY for the Etsy MCP server.

etsy_oauth2.title: ETSY_OAUTH2
etsy_oauth2.description: Sets ETSY_OAUTH2 for the Etsy MCP server.

etsy_shared_secret.title: ETSY_SHARED_SECRET
etsy_shared_secret.description: Sets ETSY_SHARED_SECRET for the Etsy MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.

etsy_shop_id.title: ETSY_SHOP_ID
etsy_shop_id.description: Sets ETSY_SHOP_ID for the endpoint template variable {shop_id}.
